import unittest

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.contacts import format_contacts

class ContactTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rows_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        rows = format_contacts([
            Student("2", "Young", "Zed", "B1", "zed@x.org"),
            Student("1", "Adams", "Al", "A10", "al@x.org"),
        ])
        self.assertTrue(rows[0].startswith("Adams, Al "))
        first, second = rows
        self.assertEqual(
            first.index("A10"), second.index("B1")
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            first.index("al@"), second.index("zed@")
        )

    def test_missing_email_names_student(self):
        pupil = Student("3", "Lee", "Kim", "C2")
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError) as caught:
            format_contacts([pupil])
        self.assertIn("Lee, Kim", str(caught.exception))

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            format_contacts([])
